Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.api

Class MandelaScriptEngineFactory

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.api.MandelaScriptEngineFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
ScriptEngineFactory
public final class MandelaScriptEngineFactory extends Object implements ScriptEngineFactory
The discovery half of the JSR-223 pair: what a registry reads before anyone has an engine.

ScriptEngineManager finds this class through META-INF/services/javax.script.ScriptEngineFactory and uses getNames(), getExtensions() and getMimeTypes() to answer getEngineByName("mandela"), getEngineByExtension("mnd") and a content-type lookup. Nothing here constructs a runtime, holds state or reads a file, so the class is safe for a registry to instantiate speculatively and is cheap to have on a classpath.

The identity it reports is the identity in Mandela — one place decides what the language is called, what version it is and what a file ends with — so a host that asks the registry and a host that imports the facade cannot be told different names for the same engine.
